limitations: Single-host fixed 64-job workload with normal WAL synchronization, CLI processes, logging, and polling.
Power and thermal checks occur at boundaries, not continuously; unavailable telemetry does not rule out throttling.
OS placement across unequal M4 core classes and background activity are uncontrolled; load observations are retained.
Five repetitions show observed variation, not a strong confidence interval or a general capacity limit.
Speedup is the ratio of the fresh one-worker median to each configuration median; old development samples are excluded.
Mean accepted job latency includes FIFO queue waiting; these are elapsed times, not CPU execution times.
No fault injection, multi-host network scaling, or controlled recovery performance is measured here.
